body:
# GarnierArmor

**Enhanced armor durability display for Minecraft. See precise durability values with color-coded warnings directly on your HUD.**

This Fabric mod collection includes two mods: **Garnier Core Library** (dependency loader) and **GarnierArmor** (armor durability HUD display).

## Features

- **Precise Values**: Exact durability numbers (current/max) and percentages
- **Color Warnings**: Green (>75%), Yellow (50-75%), Orange (25-50%), Red (<25%)
- **Real-time Updates**: Instant display when taking damage or repairing
- **All Armor Pieces**: Shows helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots separately
- **ModMenu Support**: Configuration screen with feature overview

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.16.9+
- Fabric API 0.107.0+
- Java 21+

## Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/)
2. Download [Fabric API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api)
3. Place both JAR files in your `mods` folder:
   - `garnierarmor-1.0.0.jar`

## Building

```batch
gradlew.bat build
```

Compiled mods:
- `armor-durability/build/libs/garnierarmor-1.0.0.jar`

## Development

```batch
gradlew.bat runClient
```
